title: Level 1 (Beginner) - A-1
notes:
There are 8 top tricks (4 club tricks and 2 each in hearts and diamonds). The defense has attacked spades, and threatens to take 5 tricks in that suit if South is not careful.

South can guarantee a stopper in spades and at the same time ensure developing a ninth trick by simply not playing dummy's ♠Q at trick one. No matter how the defensive spades are distributed, East and West will have no answer to this play.

Once South gets on lead he can develop another trick in diamonds if that suit is divided 3-3. South only needs 9 tricks, however, and should take them without surrendering the lead.
